newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ever-Gotesco slips in heavy late trade.
newsitem.headline: Ever-Gotesco slips in heavy late trade.

text.p: Retail firm Ever-Gotesco Resources and Holdings Inc slipped by four centavos, or 3.33 percent, to 1.16 pesos in heavy late trade in Manila on Monday, brokers said.
"Weak hands are selling the shares. Some took the stock for trading purposes only," Dick Puig of Peregrine Securities said.
The stock rose by 20 percent in five days from its listing Monday last week. It was offered at one peso apiece.
It is the most actively traded issue in the commercial-industrial sector on Monday.
